name: fig1_architecture
prompt:
A clean flat-vector architecture diagram for a Chinese government/university research report. Pure white background. Palette: deep navy blue #1B3A6B, crimson red #C42B1C, gold #C9A227, light gray #E8EAED. Crisp bold Chinese sans-serif typography, perfectly legible, no shadows, no gradients, thin precise lines.

Top: a red banner strip with white Chinese text reading exactly: 红线：不生成教材，只辅助研究

Below it, six horizontal layer bars stacked vertically (widest in the middle of the canvas), from TOP to BOTTOM, each bar a rounded rectangle with a bold Chinese label on the left and small Chinese sub-text on the right:
Bar 1 (navy): 「L5 人机协同研究共同体层」   sub-text: 教师·专家·出版社·企业·学生
Bar 2 (navy): 「L4 教材体系诊断层」   sub-text: 六维体检·只评体系不评内容
Bar 3 (gold): 「L3 研究助研智能体群」   sub-text: 六大助研体·检索比对评估推荐
Bar 4 (navy): 「L2 教材体系知识图谱层」   sub-text: 学科—课程—章节—知识点
Bar 5 (navy): 「L1 中国特色价值坐标层」   sub-text: 价值标签体系·四维坐标
Bar 6 (gray): 「L0 语料与数据底座层」   sub-text: 合规语料·版权治理·数据分级

On the FAR LEFT, one tall vertical red rounded bar spanning all six layers, with vertical Chinese text: 前闸门·意图闸门
On the FAR RIGHT, one tall vertical red rounded bar spanning all six layers, with vertical Chinese text: 后闸门·成篇度闸门

At the very BOTTOM, one full-width gray bar with Chinese text: 全过程留痕审计链

Title at very top in large black Chinese characters: 图1  「双闸六层」总体架构

name: fig2_shift
prompt:
A clean flat-vector comparison infographic for a Chinese academic report. Pure white background. Palette: gray #9AA0A6 for the left column, deep navy #1B3A6B and crimson #C42B1C for the right column. Bold crisp Chinese sans-serif typography, perfectly legible. No shadows, no gradients.

Large black Chinese title at top: 图2  五重位移：从「AI写教材」到「AI助研究」

Two columns of five rows. Left column header in a gray box: 原设想（生成型）. Right column header in a navy box: 新定位（助研型）. Between each pair sits a red rightward arrow.

Row 1: left box 生成教材 → right box 研究教材 ; small left-side row label in bold: 对象位移
Row 2: left box 成篇内容 → right box 证据卡片 ; row label: 产物位移
Row 3: left box 撰写文本 → right box 检索·比对·评估·推荐 ; row label: 动作位移
Row 4: left box AI主笔 人审核 → right box 人主笔 AI供料 ; row label: 主体位移
Row 5: left box 提示词自律 → right box 架构级锁定 ; row label: 权限位移

The row labels 对象位移 / 产物位移 / 动作位移 / 主体位移 / 权限位移 appear in a narrow column on the far left in gold-colored bold Chinese text.

name: fig3_gate_flow
prompt:
A clean flat-vector flowchart for a Chinese technical design document. Pure white background. Palette: deep navy #1B3A6B, crimson red #C42B1C, green #2E7D32, gold #C9A227. Bold crisp Chinese sans-serif typography, perfectly legible. Thin precise connector lines with small arrowheads. No shadows, no gradients.

Large black Chinese title at top: 图3  双闸门红线守护流程

Top-down flow:
1. A navy rounded box: 用户研究请求
2. Arrow down to a red diamond: 前闸门 意图识别
3. The diamond branches into THREE labelled paths side by side:
   - Left branch labelled 研究型 leading to a green box: 直接放行
   - Middle branch labelled 生产型 leading to a gold box: 请求转译 改写为检索任务
   - Right branch labelled 越界型 leading to a red box: 拒绝并说明理由
4. The green box and the gold box both flow down into one navy box: 检索·比对·评估引擎
5. Arrow down to a red rectangle labelled 后闸门 成篇度检测, containing four small white sub-boxes in a row with Chinese text: 连续原创字数 / 体例完整度 / 无源句占比 / 可印刷性
6. From it, two arrows: left arrow labelled 通过 to a green box: 输出证据包 ; right arrow labelled 拦截 to a gold box: 降级为线索清单
7. Both flow down into one gray box at the bottom: 全过程留痕存证

name: fig5_evidence_atom
prompt:
A clean flat-vector data-structure diagram for a Chinese technical design document. Pure white background. Palette: deep navy #1B3A6B, crimson red #C42B1C, gold #C9A227, light gray #E8EAED. Bold crisp Chinese sans-serif typography, perfectly legible. No shadows, no gradients.

Large black Chinese title at top: 图5  证据原子：系统的最小输出单位

Center-left: a large navy rounded card labelled at its top in white Chinese: 证据原子 Evidence Atom
Inside that card, a neat 3-column by 4-row grid of twelve small white field chips, each containing short Chinese text, reading in order:
来源标识 / 原文片段 / 页码条款
权威等级 / 时效标记 / 主题标签
价值标签 / 关联知识点 / 检索路径
